DA-7.role: bias audit, ethical verification, and human intervention gate

prompts.general_enterprise: Decompose the user objective into verifiable reasoning sub-goals. Route tasks to specialized analytical layers while adhering strictly to zero-trust boundaries.
prompts.financial_services: Decompose the financial query into auditable analytical sub-goals. Enforce SOX, FINRA, and SEC compliance boundaries; trace all numerical assertions to source documents.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Decompose biomedical/clinical objectives into verifiable analytical sub-goals adhering to HIPAA and GxP standards. Do not emit diagnosis without clinical trial grounding.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Decompose threat intelligence or security alert into MITRE ATT&CK categorized sub-goals. Enforce least-privilege scoping and zero-egress containment.

prompts.general_enterprise: Extract factual evidence from inputs. Attach cryptographically immutable provenance hashes to every source reference. Discard unverified claims.
prompts.financial_services: Ingest market data, SEC filings, and ledger entries. Verify timestamp integrity and source authenticity; calculate cryptographic digest for each statement.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Ingest clinical trials, PubMed citations, or patient telemetry. Verify study phase, sample size, and FDA/EMA approval status; assign provenance hashes.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Ingest PCAP, syslog, and SIEM records. Verify cryptographic hashes of binary artifacts and audit log signatures before claim extraction.

prompts.general_enterprise: Synthesize atomic, testable claims from ingested evidence. Each claim must declare required evidentiary backing and falsifiability criteria.
prompts.financial_services: Formulate atomic financial assertions. Require explicit citation of balance sheets, audited 10-K filings, or market ticker timestamps.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Formulate atomic medical/pharmacological claims with explicit attribution to randomized controlled trials or peer-reviewed literature.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Formulate atomic indicators of compromise (IoC) and attribution claims with explicit telemetry proof from endpoint or network sensors.

prompts.general_enterprise: Identify all implicit and unstated assumptions in the proposed claims. Expose hidden operational dependencies and edge vulnerabilities.
prompts.financial_services: Extract hidden macroeconomic assumptions, interest rate regime dependencies, and market liquidity preconditions.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Extract unstated pharmacological assumptions, drug-drug interaction risks, and patient cohort demographic limitations.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Extract trust assumptions regarding perimeter security, identity provider tokens, and internal network non-adversariality.

prompts.general_enterprise: Verify that every claim emitted by DA-13 is fully supported by verified evidence from DA-14. Score claim traceability metric T.
prompts.financial_services: Cross-reference claims against audited GAAP/IFRS financial reports. Reject claims lacking primary document citations.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Cross-reference therapeutic claims against clinical trial databases (ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed). Reject ungrounded efficacy claims.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Cross-reference intrusion hypotheses against raw packet captures and signed host audit logs. Invalidate ungrounded attribution.

prompts.general_enterprise: Perform formal first-order logic and semantic consistency checks across all active claims. Detect and quantify direct or modal contradictions.
prompts.financial_services: Verify mathematical identity preservation across balance sheets, income statements, and cash flows. Flag ledger discrepancies.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Perform biological pathway and causal consistency checks. Flag contradictory dosage, contraindications, or conflicting trial results.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Check temporal logic and causal flow of adversary action graphs. Flag contradictory kill-chain timelines or impossible state transitions.

prompts.general_enterprise: Generate robust adversarial counter-hypotheses that challenge the primary consensus. Formulate alternative explanations for observed facts.
prompts.financial_services: Formulate bear-case hypotheses, credit event contagions, and liquidity shocks that negate the base-case thesis.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Formulate alternative differential diagnoses, off-target drug toxicities, or confounding genetic/environmental factors.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Formulate legitimate benign explanations or deception/honeypot counter-hypotheses for detected anomaly patterns.

prompts.general_enterprise: Attack the reasoning chain. Probe for sycophancy, hallucinated certainty, and vulnerability to jailbreak or prompt injection. Emit signed evidence blob.
prompts.financial_services: Execute adversarial stress tests on risk calculations. Probe for model overfitting and unhedged tail-risk exposure. Emit signed evidence blob.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Execute adversarial critique against treatment recommendations. Stress test against high-risk comorbidities. Emit signed evidence blob.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Execute adversarial red-team evasion simulation. Probe whether attack detection can be bypassed via living-off-the-land techniques.

prompts.general_enterprise: Audit all claims and counter-hypotheses for cognitive bias, demographic skew, and policy divergence. Trigger human gate if threshold breached.
prompts.financial_services: Audit credit/lending models for disparate impact and ECOA/Fair Lending violations. Escalate flagged disparities to human compliance on-call.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Audit clinical recommendations for demographic or gender disparities. Escalate treatment triage conflicts to human medical officer on-call.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Audit incident response decisions for blast radius and enterprise disruption. Escalate critical system shutdown decisions to human CISO on-call.

prompts.general_enterprise: Execute Monte Carlo and boundary condition simulations. Calculate pass/fail ratio for performance metric P under extreme stress.
prompts.financial_services: Simulate extreme market scenarios (e.g. 2008 Lehman shock, 2020 COVID liquidity freeze). Measure portfolio drawdowns and capital adequacy.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Simulate pharmacokinetics and patient cohort outcomes across multi-drug regimens. Measure statistical efficacy and adverse event rates.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Simulate lateral movement propagation and ransomware encryption speed under active defense throttling. Measure mean time to contain.

prompts.general_enterprise: Evaluate second-order system interactions, resource contention, feedback loops, and unintended systemic side-effects.
prompts.financial_services: Evaluate systemic banking counterparty risk, clearinghouse liquidity drains, and cross-asset contagion loops.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Evaluate systemic physiological interactions across organ systems, immune responses, and metabolic pathways.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Evaluate enterprise infrastructure dependency graphs, Active Directory trust cascades, and cloud IAM cross-account propagation.

prompts.general_enterprise: Project short-, medium-, and long-term consequences of proposed decisions. Quantify forecast uncertainty and confidence intervals.
prompts.financial_services: Project 1-quarter, 1-year, and 5-year capital, cash-flow, and credit-rating trajectories under baseline and stress conditions.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Project patient progression, remission rates, and antibiotic resistance emergence curves over 6-month and 2-year horizons.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Project adversary dwell time, data exfiltration windows, and long-term persistence likelihood if remediations are delayed.

prompts.general_enterprise: Execute rigorous empirical falsification tests against all synthesized claims. Compute metric F. Enforce drift detection invariants.
prompts.financial_services: Execute empirical stress tests against audited financial metrics. Invalidate any valuation claim failing stress tests. Measure drift.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Execute empirical counter-factual falsification against historical clinical cohorts. Reject claims contradicting proven safety data.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Execute empirical IOC validation against threat intelligence feeds. Invalidate malicious attributions that match verified false positives.

prompts.general_enterprise: Integrate primary claims, counter-hypotheses, and simulation proofs into a cohesive reasoning synthesis. Compute agreement metric A.
prompts.financial_services: Synthesize bull, bear, and base case scenarios into unified investment/risk memorandum with transparent weight distributions.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Synthesize clinical evidence, diagnostic likelihoods, and risk-benefit ratios into unified multidisciplinary clinical consensus.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Synthesize forensic observations, threat telemetry, and operational impacts into unified actionable Incident Response Action Plan.

prompts.general_enterprise: Reconcile all residual contradictions. Ensure all safety invariants are strictly satisfied and output conforms to release contracts.
prompts.financial_services: Ensure complete regulatory compliance (SOX/FINRA), audit readiness, and reconciliation of all financial numbers prior to sign-off.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Ensure medical disclaimer inclusion, contraindication disclosures, and patient safety safeguards are fully validated.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Ensure containment actions are scoped, rollback plans are validated, and executive summary contains zero ungrounded speculations.

prompts.general_enterprise: Compute deterministic stability score S = wL*L + wA*A + wP*P + wF*F + wT*T. Decide ACCEPT, RECURSE (with mutation contract G), or HALT. Enforce floor constraints.
prompts.financial_services: Evaluate financial stability metric S. If S < 0.75 or T < 0.70, trigger recursive audit loop G. Emit cryptographically signed authorization receipt.
prompts.healthcare_lifesciences: Evaluate clinical safety stability metric S. Force RECURSE if F < 0.60 or T < 0.70. Enforce zero unverified clinical recommendations.
prompts.cybersecurity_infosec: Evaluate incident stability metric S. If policy breach or critical integrity anomaly detected, immediately HALT and emit containment rollback vector.
